manifest.name: gdn-mlp-q4k-skip-layer0
manifest.description: Combine Q4_K on recurrent projections and MLP blocks after layer 0. Keep the first GDN and MLP blocks NVFP4 to preserve their batched-prefill dispatch, and keep every attention projection at baseline to avoid V5's task loss. V4 and V6 separately pass holdout and save memory; test whether their combined savings survive without V9's first-layer prefill penalty. Interactions, task retention and private holdout require evaluator measurement.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
